body.content: Speculating on 'Behavioral Correlation': Even if the stacks are 100% diverse (different languages, different clouds), if all services use the same 'Auto-Scaling' logic or 'Circuit Breaker' thresholds, they might all trip at the same time in response to a global traffic spike. This is a 'correlation of logic' rather than a 'correlation of infrastructure'.
body.why_keep_this: Adds a layer to the 'evidence' part of the problem beyond just dependency trees.
